up: Retrieve the first 1000 activity rows for the human single-protein target CHEMBL3243 (Receptor-type tyrosine-protein phosphatase C) that are of the standard type IC50 and have a pChEMBL value. Only include rows where the standard relation is '=' and the pChEMBL value is not null. The results should be ordered by molecule ChEMBL ID and then by assay ChEMBL ID. Return the assay ChEMBL ID, target type, taxonomy ID (tax_id), canonical SMILES, molecule ChEMBL ID, standard type, and pChEMBL value.
sql:
WITH target_activities AS (
  SELECT
    a.activity_id,
    ass.chembl_id AS assay_chembl_id,
    td.target_type,
    td.tax_id,
    a.molregno,
    a.standard_type,
    a.pchembl_value,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      ORDER BY md.chembl_id, ass.chembl_id
    ) AS _rn
  FROM activities a
  JOIN assays ass ON a.assay_id = ass.assay_id
  JOIN target_dictionary td ON ass.tid = td.tid
  JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON a.molregno = md.molregno
  WHERE td.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL3243'
    AND a.standard_type = 'IC50'
    AND a.standard_relation = '='
    AND a.pchembl_value IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT
  ta.assay_chembl_id,
  ta.target_type,
  ta.tax_id,
  cs.canonical_smiles,
  md.chembl_id AS molecule_chembl_id,
  ta.standard_type,
  ta.pchembl_value
FROM target_activities ta
JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON ta.molregno = md.molregno
LEFT JOIN compound_structures cs ON ta.molregno = cs.molregno
WHERE ta._rn <= 1000
ORDER BY md.chembl_id, ta.assay_chembl_id;
